# statusdrift_api_key (Data Source)

Fetches a single API key by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statusdrift_api_key" "by_name" {
  name = "CI/CD Pipeline Key"
}

data "statusdrift_api_key" "by_id" {
  id = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the API key.
- `name` (String) The name of the API key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date/time the API key was created.
- `expires_at` (String) The expiration date/time in ISO 8601 format, or null if non-expiring.
- `is_expired` (Boolean) Whether the API key has expired.
- `key_prefix` (String) The first 12 characters of the API key.
- `last_used_at` (String) The date/time the API key was last used.
- `permissions` (Attributes) Permissions granted to this API key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
